concepts.name: Social/temporal-temporoparietal connectivity
concepts.prompt_asd: Autism spectrum disorder has been investigated in relation to heterogeneous functional connectivity differences involving temporal and temporoparietal systems associated with social information processing.
concepts.prompt_td: In typical development, temporal and temporoparietal functional systems contribute to social information processing, with substantial individual variation in connectivity.

medical_source.source: Gotts et al. 2012 Fractionation of social brain circuits
medical_source.boundary: 群体社会网络连通性关联；不推出全部颞顶连接同向变化或个体病灶。

concepts.name: Frontoparietal/executive connectivity
concepts.prompt_asd: Research on autism has examined variable frontoparietal connectivity patterns potentially related to executive control and attention regulation.
concepts.prompt_td: Typical development includes variable frontoparietal connectivity supporting executive control and attention regulation.

medical_source.source: Just et al. 2007 frontal-parietal executive underconnectivity
medical_source.boundary: 任务fMRI研究，仅支持宽泛候选先验；不可直接变成静息FC固定下降标签。

concepts.name: Thalamocortical/sensorimotor connectivity
concepts.prompt_asd: Autism research has investigated heterogeneous thalamocortical and sensorimotor connectivity patterns in relation to sensory processing differences.
concepts.prompt_td: In typical development, thalamocortical and sensorimotor connectivity contributes to sensory processing with individual variability.

medical_source.boundary: 丘脑皮层研究支持候选范围，异质方向不设hyper/hypo真值。

concepts.name: Cingulate-insular/salience connectivity
concepts.prompt_asd: Autism studies have explored differences in cingulate and insular connectivity potentially associated with salience and internal signal processing.
concepts.prompt_td: Cingulate and insular systems in typical development support processing of salient and internal information with individual variation.

medical_source.source: Uddin et al. 2013 salience network connectivity
medical_source.boundary: 岛叶/前扣带线索不验证整个扣带/岛叶域为单一salience网络；当前HO锚点刻意粗粒度。
